purpose: Three additional concept alternatives; every design includes one enclosed equipment room; no runtime map edits

variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: detailed final 2D game level art concept, southeast prison factory courtyard district.
Input image 1: authoritative original map geometry reference, the three overlapping red rectangles identify the district to redesign.
Input image 2: painted sprite style and close-up framing reference from the previous courtyard concept; use it to match the rendering, not as a fixed prop arrangement.
Produce a NEW alternative for this exact district. Zoom in on the courtyard from the kiosk and existing tree garden at the top, down to the CLOSED perimeter wall at bottom, with laundry/bath building contextual edge on the left and long warehouse contextual edge on the right. The existing kiosk, tree-and-monument garden, laundry, warehouse and perimeter wall must stay at their existing relative locations and sizes. Change the previously empty south courtyard ground only; do not delete or move these existing buildings. Remove editor UI, red outlines, editor dots and old disconnected dark rectangle/L-shaped floor patches; walking pavement is continuous worn grey-green tile.
MANDATORY: the new design contains ONE clearly defined enclosed equipment room, not merely outdoor machinery. Draw this equipment room as a CUTAWAY GAME ROOM with roof lifted off, solid pale stone walls on all four sides with a real door gap, cream coping and worn dark teal lower wall strip, concrete floor, obvious blue steel double door in the appropriate wall plane, small cream plaque reading exactly "设备间". The door and walls obey the SAME overhead camera as all existing buildings, not a front-elevation blue rectangle pasted facing the viewer. Interior contains one modest cylindrical hot-water/pressure tank, one motor-and-pump assembly, grey electrical control cabinets and tidy red/blue pipe runs following the walls, yellow maintenance clearance lines and one small steel service table. Leave a continuous walking aisle inside from the door to all machines. Realistic sprite-scale machinery, not a giant sci-fi reactor. Room exterior has a small vent and minimal service pipes, but the INTERIOR must be visible in the concept to show the layout. No full roof hiding equipment and no large second new building.
KEEP ROUTES: broad north-south circulation from tree/kiosk to lower court; uninterrupted east-west service road just inside the south perimeter, connecting laundry to warehouse/logistics; preserve all existing door approaches and a passage between new room and neighboring buildings. No new gate or gap in southern external wall. Keep objects mostly along edges; at least one third of the south courtyard is clear paving for walking and patrols. Modest green islands with soft dirt/grass and small pebble borders, worn timber benches and restrained lamps provide human scale.
Style: polished 2D hand-painted sprite game art matching references, straight orthographic top-down, slight visible object front faces like the reference, not isometric or perspectival. Muted olive, warm grey, cream stone, weathered navy-blue steel, rust and wood. Short consistent shadows, fine details, readable silhouettes. 3 orange-uniform prisoners and 1 navy guard, small and spaced on paths. No fountains, no sports court, no futuristic elements, no arbitrary clutter.
Output landscape 3:2 image with a modest cream caption band OUTSIDE the map along the bottom. No explanatory arrows, no editor overlays; show a finished believable district.
VARIANT FOUR: exact caption "方案四 · 仓库南侧设备间". Locate the equipment room in the SOUTHEAST pocket, directly south of the warehouse but separated from it by a clear crosswalk/door approach. Its footprint is a compact roughly square room, about one third the width of the existing warehouse and sized comfortably for the specified equipment; entry opens west onto the courtyard and is drawn correctly within a north-south wall. Pipes run toward the warehouse along the service edge. Put a small low planting strip along the room's north/left approach, and a cart and one pallet near its outer right service side without obscuring door. The large southwest court has a compact planted pergola in the upper-left part, one chess table, two benches and a single modest irregular pebble-bordered lawn island. Retain the tree garden as the north anchor. Keep the center and bottom road open. The new room balances the garden visually on the right.
